What is the best place in the states to take a disc golf vacation?

I was in Beaver Creek and Vail recently, and the courses are pretty nice. Good variety of challenging and easy holes, a lot of elevation obviously. Some of the tees aren't marked very well, but it's relatively easy to navigate the courses.

Illinois has some good courses in Highland Park, too. Less terrain, more trees.

Thanks for this. A Colorado trip is now on the list. There are some pictures of the courses online I found and they look awesome. So $30 for an all day ski lift pass that works at both courses if I'm understanding correctly?

Yeah, but if you're going for more than a couple days there's a $70 pass for a week also at both courses. It's kind of hard to find, there are so many ticket options.

EDIT: there's also great food. Blue Moose Pizza has locations in both villages, Nudoru Ramen Bar is outside of Vail Village, Mountain Standard has stylish American cuisine inside Vail Village, and Hooked has some good sushi in Beaver Creek Village; just to name a few.

The toxic mine stuff reminds of "Red Road" on IFC. I wouldn't be surprised if Caspere's murder is due to him either possibly being "loose lips" on the whole thing, or some manner of payback for profiting from it.

Just like last year, a big shootout and the shutting down of a confirmed scumbag will keep the periphery characters thinking it is a done deal, while something else lurks in the background. The difference this year is that there isn't much room to build a lie out of the shootout itself, and we will see the fallout in real time. This season is interesting, but it feels more clouded in vagary than menace.
